title: Small-bias generator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\ell$ be a nonzero natural number, and let $r,s$ lie in the binary extension field of degree $\ell$. The generator produces the length-$n$ binary vector whose coordinate at position $i$ is the binary dot product of the field-coordinate encoding of $r^{i+1}$ with the encoding of $s$.
hypotheses_covered: The field elements $r$ and $s$ belong to the binary extension field of degree $\ell$
caveat: The supplied definitions do not describe the binary field encoding or the binary dot product, so the output coordinate can only be characterized by those operations in words.
